announce.slfrontier.level_up.sub: Spend your stat points in the avatar menu (K)
dialogue.slfrontier.bilac.hello.1: Oh! A customer! I'm Bilac, the best blacksmith in Rabituza. Probably in the whole Frontier.
dialogue.slfrontier.bilac.hello.2: Bring me materials and I'll forge you something amazing. What'll it be?
dialogue.slfrontier.emul.invite.1: Wahh, you're alive! I saw everything — you fought the Nightslayer!
dialogue.slfrontier.emul.invite.2: That glowing mark... It's Lycagon's Mark. The Nightslayer only marks prey it finds interesting.
dialogue.slfrontier.emul.invite.3: I'm Emul. I'm a Vorpal Bunny, from Rabituza — our hidden country.
dialogue.slfrontier.emul.invite.4: Our king, Vysache, wants to meet anyone who carries that mark. Nobody has ever been invited before!
dialogue.slfrontier.emul.invite.5: So... will you come with me to Rabituza?
dialogue.slfrontier.emul.marked_stranger: That smell... Lycagon's Mark. You're the one the Nightslayer chose.
My brother told me to keep an eye on people like you.
dialogue.slfrontier.emul.other.1: Sorry, I'm already traveling with someone!
dialogue.slfrontier.emul.partner.1: Let's go, partner! I'll back you up with Magic Edge.
dialogue.slfrontier.emul.partner.2: If you ever want to go home to Rabituza, just say so.
dialogue.slfrontier.emul.partner_complet: We did it! Lycagon is gone and your mark is gone too!
dialogue.slfrontier.emul.partner_final.2: I believe in you. Let's end the night together!
dialogue.slfrontier.emul.partner_moonbla: Big brother can awaken your Vorpal Choppers. He just needs a Quad Beetle shell.
Quad Beetles live in the Prismatic Forest Grotto. They're... really big.
dialogue.slfrontier.emul.partner_tombgua: The garden of red lilies... I've heard a ghost lives there.
If we're fighting a samurai, I'm staying WAY behind you.
dialogue.slfrontier.emul.shy.1: Eep! A human! ...You're not going to eat me, are you?
dialogue.slfrontier.emul.shy.2: I'm just a Vorpal Bunny passing through. Nothing to see here!
dialogue.slfrontier.guide.about.1: This world is called the Frontier. Everything here — the towns, the monsters, even you — exists inside the game.
dialogue.slfrontier.guide.about.2: When you're done for the day, use your headset again to log out. You'll log back in right where you left off.
dialogue.slfrontier.guide.about.3: Stamina drains while you sprint and when you use skills. Stop to catch your breath.
dialogue.slfrontier.guide.about.4: And beware the night. There are things out there no beginner should meet. Shall we start?
dialogue.slfrontier.guide.complete.1: The Nightslayer, slain! Every player in the Frontier is talking about you.
dialogue.slfrontier.guide.complete.2: There's still a whole world out there. Go and explore it.
dialogue.slfrontier.guide.final.1: Word is, the Tombguard has fallen. That was you, wasn't it?
dialogue.slfrontier.guide.final.2: Then only the Nightslayer remains. Go — end the night.
The Blacksmith is just east of the fountain, by the forge.
Gray Ore? That comes from the Diremarsh Waste. Your compass will point the way.
dialogue.slfrontier.guide.goblins_done.1: Five goblins! Not bad at all for a beginner.
dialogue.slfrontier.guide.goblins_done.2: Here — an old adventurer left this mask behind. Strange-looking thing, but it makes your feet lighter.
dialogue.slfrontier.guide.goblins_done.3: Next, visit the Blacksmith across the road. He's been grumbling about ore all week.
dialogue.slfrontier.guide.goblins_progre: Goblins defeated: %s of %s. Keep going — they're all over the plains.
Hold one blade in each hand: your off-hand blade follows up every hit.
dialogue.slfrontier.guide.marked.1: That mark on your skin... You met the Nightslayer and lived?!
dialogue.slfrontier.guide.marked.2: Lycagon's Mark. It won't let you wear armor on your body or legs. Only killing Lycagon will lift it.
dialogue.slfrontier.guide.marked.3: Strange — I hear it makes the rabbits of the Frontier curious about you.
dialogue.slfrontier.guide.nightslayer_ru: Have you heard? Hunters keep finding a black stone altar deep in the dark woods.
They say that if you touch it after dark, the Nightslayer comes. A wolf the size of a house.
Nobody who has seen it has won. Most never even scratched it.
...You're going anyway, aren't you? Of course you are.
dialogue.slfrontier.guide.tombguard_rumo: There's an old tale about a garden of red lilies and a samurai who never stops guarding a grave.
If you find it, be respectful. Some stories are sad for a reason.
dialogue.slfrontier.guide.welcome.1: Ah, a new face! Welcome to Fastera, the first town of Shangri-La Frontier.
dialogue.slfrontier.guide.welcome.2: Your avatar starts at level 1. Defeat monsters to earn EXP, then spend your stat points in your menu (press K).
dialogue.slfrontier.guide.welcome.3: Skills go in your four skill slots (Z, X, C, V). Use them often — skills that are used enough can evolve.
dialogue.slfrontier.guide.welcome.4: Ready to begin? I have a few things that will help.
dialogue.slfrontier.option.ask_frontier: Tell me about the Frontier first.
dialogue.slfrontier.option.buy_holy_wate: Brew Holy Water (1 Gray Ore + 1 Glass Bottle).
dialogue.slfrontier.option.emul_rest: Go rest in Rabituza for now.
dialogue.slfrontier.option.find_emul: Have you seen a Vorpal Bunny around here?
dialogue.slfrontier.option.forge_battleh: Forge: Battlehorn Helm (2 Quad Beetle Shells)
dialogue.slfrontier.option.forge_bee_bla: Forge: Empire Bee Twinblades (Queen's Crown + 4 Stingers)
dialogue.slfrontier.option.offer_blades: Offer the Vorpal Choppers and the shell.
dialogue.slfrontier.setsuna.early.2: Please, leave this garden in peace. It is not yet your time.
dialogue.slfrontier.setsuna.farewell: Setsuna: "Thank you... The sky is clear now."
dialogue.slfrontier.setsuna.fight.2: When he raises his blade high, that is Sky Clear. Parry it, and his guard will break.
dialogue.slfrontier.setsuna.meet.1: Oh my. A visitor. It has been so very long.
dialogue.slfrontier.setsuna.meet.2: I am Setsuna. I died here, a long time ago, in this garden of red lilies.
dialogue.slfrontier.setsuna.meet.3: The man who guarded me, Wezaemon, still stands watch over my grave. He has stood there for an eternity.
dialogue.slfrontier.setsuna.meet.4: He cannot rest until someone surpasses him. He will not hold back. He doesn't know how.
dialogue.slfrontier.setsuna.meet.5: Please. Put his soul to rest. Show him the sky is clear.
dialogue.slfrontier.setsuna.meet.6: Take this holy water. When his aura burns, it will quench it.
dialogue.slfrontier.setsuna.thanks.2: "Sky Clear"... He always got it backwards. It was supposed to be "Clear Sky."
dialogue.slfrontier.setsuna.thanks.3: Take care of his technique. He'd be proud.
dialogue.slfrontier.setsuna.thanks.4: And... there is a wolf that hunts the night. It is part of a much bigger story.
dialogue.slfrontier.smith.has_ore.1: Now THAT is Gray Ore. Give it here.
dialogue.slfrontier.smith.has_ore.2: A pair of Marsh Daggers. Light, sharp, and they won't snap on the first goblin skull.
dialogue.slfrontier.smith.idle.1: Busy, busy. Come back when you've got something worth hammering.
dialogue.slfrontier.smith.need_ore.1: Gray Ore: you have %s of %s. Six chunks and I'll make you something real.
dialogue.slfrontier.smith.need_ore_tip.1: It grows in the Diremarsh Waste. Look for dull gray stone in the mud and riverbanks.
dialogue.slfrontier.smith.regular.1: Back again? The forge is always hot.
dialogue.slfrontier.vysache.awaken.1: A fine shell. Hand me the Choppers.
dialogue.slfrontier.vysache.awaken.2: ...White for the waxing moon. Black for the waning moon.
dialogue.slfrontier.vysache.awaken.3: The Moonblades: Waxing and Waning. Hold them together and they will become the Twin Moon.
dialogue.slfrontier.vysache.awaken.4: Now. There is a ghost in a garden of red lilies who has waited a very long time for someone like you.
dialogue.slfrontier.vysache.complete.1: The Nightslayer is no more. Rabituza will sing about this for a hundred years.
dialogue.slfrontier.vysache.complete.2: You are always welcome here, friend.
dialogue.slfrontier.vysache.final.1: The Tombguard is at rest. You have grown, marked one.
dialogue.slfrontier.vysache.final.2: Lycagon waits at its den. Join the Moonblades into the Twin Moon and strike with everything.
dialogue.slfrontier.vysache.final.3: I can teach you one last technique. Crescent Vorpal — a leap that crashes down like the moon itself.
dialogue.slfrontier.vysache.meet.1: So you're the one who crossed fangs with the Nightslayer and lived. Welcome to Rabituza.
dialogue.slfrontier.vysache.meet.2: I am Vysache, king of the Vorpal Bunnies. Lycagon and I... have history.
dialogue.slfrontier.vysache.meet.3: That mark proves the wolf thinks you're worth hunting. That makes you worth helping.
dialogue.slfrontier.vysache.meet.4: Take these Vorpal Choppers. And this bell — my sister Emul will travel with you.
dialogue.slfrontier.vysache.meet.5: This collar too. It slows your growth, but every level will be worth more. Patience pays.
dialogue.slfrontier.vysache.meet.6: Grow strong, marked one. When you're ready, the Choppers can become far more.
dialogue.slfrontier.vysache.need_chopper: Where are the Vorpal Choppers I gave you? Both of them, mind you.
I can't awaken blades you don't have.
dialogue.slfrontier.vysache.need_shell.1: To awaken the Choppers, I need a Quad Beetle Shell from the Prismatic Forest Grotto.
dialogue.slfrontier.vysache.need_shell.2: The beetles are tough. Aim for weak points — strike from behind.
dialogue.slfrontier.vysache.setsuna.1: Setsuna of Distant Days waits in the Hidden Garden, among the red spider lilies.
dialogue.slfrontier.vysache.setsuna.2: Her samurai, Wezaemon, still guards her grave. He has forgotten why.
dialogue.slfrontier.vysache.setsuna.3: Bring holy water. And learn to parry. You'll need both.
dialogue.slfrontier.vysache.stranger.1: Hm? A human in Rabituza, uninvited? Bold.
dialogue.slfrontier.vysache.stranger.2: Come back when you have earned a reason to be here.
gui.slfrontier.cursed_desc: No body or leg armor in the Frontier until Lycagon falls.
gui.slfrontier.map_help: Drag to pan, scroll to zoom. Right-click places a pin. Click a waypoint to travel.
gui.slfrontier.map_unavailable: The map only works inside Shangri-La Frontier.
gui.slfrontier.no_side: Talk to people around the Frontier.
gui.slfrontier.no_waypoints: Touch Waypoint Crystals and visit towns to add them here.
gui.slfrontier.slot_hint: Drag a skill onto a slot · right-click clears
gui.slfrontier.talk_to_accept: Talk to them to accept this quest.
item.slfrontier.empire_bee_queen_crown.l: Proof of victory over the Empire Bee Queen.
item.slfrontier.frontier_compass.lore: Use to point it at your current story objective.
item.slfrontier.fulldive_headset.lore: Hold use to log in to Shangri-La Frontier. Use again inside to log out.
item.slfrontier.goblin_tooth.lore: Every adventurer has a jar of these.
item.slfrontier.gray_ore_chunk.lore: Dull, heavy ore from the Diremarsh Waste. Smiths love it.
item.slfrontier.holy_water.lore: Throw it. Burns the undead and quenches their auras.
item.slfrontier.lycagon_fang.lore: Proof that the night has ended.
item.slfrontier.mud_digger_fin.lore: Taken from the "Solo Killer" of the Diremarsh Waste.
item.slfrontier.prismatic_shard.lore: It shimmers in every color at once.
item.slfrontier.quad_beetle_shell.lore: A shell harder than steel, from the Prismatic Forest Grotto.
item.slfrontier.reallocation_tonic.lore: Drink to refund every spent stat point.
item.slfrontier.rebirth_tearjewel.lore: Shatters to save you from a fatal blow while carried.
item.slfrontier.seiten_skillbook.lore: "Clear sky." Read it to learn Sky Clear.
item.slfrontier.setsuna_spawn_egg: Setsuna of Distant Days Spawn Egg
item.slfrontier.shadow_wolf_spawn_egg: Shadow of the Nightslayer Spawn Egg
item.slfrontier.vorpal_bell.lore: Ring to call Emul. Sneak-use to send her home.
item.slfrontier.vorpal_soul_collar.lore: While carried: -30%% EXP, but +5 stat points per level instead of 3.
item.slfrontier.vysache_spawn_egg: Vysache, the Rabbit King Spawn Egg
lore.slfrontier.ducusram: Marsh Daggers reforged by Bilac into longer, double-edged blades.
lore.slfrontier.empire_bee_twinblades: Bilac's work. Every cut injects venom.
lore.slfrontier.marsh_dagger: Forged from Gray Ore. Light and quick.
lore.slfrontier.mercenary_twin_blades: Cheap starter blades. Hold one in each hand.
lore.slfrontier.tombguard_katana: Wezaemon's blade. It still remembers the garden.
lore.slfrontier.twin_moon: Waxing and Waning, joined into one.
lore.slfrontier.vorpal_choppers: A gift from the Rabbit King. Fragile, but they love critical hits.
lore.slfrontier.waning: The black blade, forged by Vysache from the Vorpal Choppers.
lore.slfrontier.waxing: The white blade, forged by Vysache from the Vorpal Choppers.
message.slfrontier.altar.day: The altar is cold. The Nightslayer only hunts at night.
message.slfrontier.altar.wrong_world: The altar is just stone here. Its power belongs to the Frontier.
message.slfrontier.arrive_rabituza: Rabituza, nation of the Vorpal Bunnies
message.slfrontier.bell.silent: The bell makes no sound. Nobody is listening for it yet.
message.slfrontier.bilac.done: Bilac: "Ta-da! One %s, fresh off the anvil!"
message.slfrontier.compass.none: There's nothing to track right now.
message.slfrontier.death_penalty: Death Penalty: your avatar is weakened for a while.
message.slfrontier.empty_slot: Skill slot %s is empty — equip skills in the avatar menu (K).
message.slfrontier.goblins_done: That's enough goblins. Report back to the Guide in Fastera.
message.slfrontier.level_up: Level up! You are now level %s. Unspent stat points: %s (press K).
message.slfrontier.lycagon.appears: The night grows teeth. Lycagon the Nightslayer has appeared!
message.slfrontier.lycagon.recedes: The Nightslayer recedes into the shadows...
message.slfrontier.lycagon.slain: %s has slain Lycagon the Nightslayer! The night has ended.
message.slfrontier.marked: Lycagon's Mark has been carved into your avatar. You cannot wear body or leg armor in the Frontier.
message.slfrontier.needs_emul: Rabbit Gun needs Emul at your side.
message.slfrontier.needs_moonblade: Moon Reflection needs a Moonblade in your main hand.
message.slfrontier.needs_twin_moon: Crescent Vorpal needs the Twin Moon in your main hand.
message.slfrontier.no_dimension: The Frontier dimension failed to load. Is the mod's data pack enabled?
message.slfrontier.outside_frontier: Your avatar's power only exists inside Shangri-La Frontier.
message.slfrontier.scenario_ex_started: [World Announcement] %s has started Unique Scenario EX: The Tombguard!
message.slfrontier.side_ready: %s is ready to turn in to %s.
message.slfrontier.smith.holy_water_cost: Holy Water costs 1 Gray Ore and 1 Glass Bottle.
message.slfrontier.stats_reset: Your stat points have been refunded.
message.slfrontier.tearjewel: The Rebirth Tearjewel shatters and pulls you back!
message.slfrontier.tip.keys: Tip: K opens your avatar menu. Z X C V use your skill slots. The compass points to your objective.
message.slfrontier.tip.twin_blades: Tip: put one twin blade in each hand (F swaps hands).
message.slfrontier.travel.combat: You can't fast travel during a fight.
message.slfrontier.travel.disabled: Fast travel is disabled on this world.
message.slfrontier.travel.not_attuned: You haven't attuned to that waypoint yet.
message.slfrontier.travel.outside: Fast travel only works inside the Frontier.
message.slfrontier.twin_moon.free_hand: Empty your off hand to split the Twin Moon.
message.slfrontier.twin_moon.joined: Waxing and Waning become the Twin Moon!
message.slfrontier.twin_moon.need_both: Hold Waxing in one hand and Waning in the other.
message.slfrontier.twin_moon.split: The Twin Moon splits into Waxing and Waning.
message.slfrontier.waypoint.wrong_world: The crystal is silent outside the Frontier.
message.slfrontier.waypoint_attuned: Attuned to %s — this is now your respawn point.
message.slfrontier.waypoint_found: Waypoint discovered: %s. Open the map (M) to fast travel.
message.slfrontier.wezaemon.parried: %s parried Sky Clear! The Tombguard's sword flies from his hands!
message.slfrontier.wezaemon.sky_clear: Wezaemon raises his blade... SKY CLEAR! Parry it!
message.slfrontier.wezaemon.subjugated: [World Announcement] Wezaemon the Tombguard has been subjugated!
quest.slfrontier.act.1: Act I — First Steps in Fastera
quest.slfrontier.act.4: Act IV — The Night Must End
quest.slfrontier.complete.journal: Lycagon the Nightslayer has fallen and its mark is gone. The whole Frontier is talking about you — and there is still a world's worth of secrets out there.
quest.slfrontier.complete.objective: The Nightslayer has fallen. The Frontier is yours to explore.
quest.slfrontier.complete.title: Frontier Pioneer
quest.slfrontier.find_setsuna.journal: With the Moonblades in hand, Vysache sent you to a garden of red spider lilies where a ghost has waited for longer than anyone remembers.
quest.slfrontier.find_setsuna.objective: Find Setsuna of Distant Days in the Hidden Garden.
quest.slfrontier.find_setsuna.title: A Garden of Red Lilies
quest.slfrontier.goblin_hunt.journal: Goblins have been raiding the fields around Fastera. The Guide gave you a pair of mercenary blades and a compass and asked you to thin their numbers. Strike from behind to hit their weak points.
quest.slfrontier.goblin_hunt.objective: Defeat Goblins on the plains around Fastera, then report back to the Guide.
quest.slfrontier.goblin_hunt.title: First Blood
quest.slfrontier.gray_ore.journal: Fastera's blacksmith has run out of Gray Ore, the dull, heavy stone that only surfaces in the mud of the Diremarsh Waste. Bring him six chunks and he'll forge you something worth carrying.
quest.slfrontier.gray_ore.objective: Mine 6 Gray Ore in the Diremarsh Waste (follow the Frontier Compass) and bring it to the Fastera Blacksmith.
quest.slfrontier.gray_ore.title: Ore for the Smith
quest.slfrontier.invitation.journal: You survived Lycagon, but it carved its mark into your avatar: no armor on your body or legs until the wolf is dead. A small white rabbit has been watching you ever since...
quest.slfrontier.invitation.objective: Lycagon has marked you. Speak with the Vorpal Bunny who found you.
quest.slfrontier.invitation.title: Invitation from Rabituza
quest.slfrontier.meet_guide.journal: You opened your eyes in Fastera's plaza, a brand-new avatar with nothing to your name. The Guide by the fountain helps every newcomer find their feet.
quest.slfrontier.meet_guide.objective: Talk to the Guide by the fountain in Fastera.
quest.slfrontier.meet_guide.title: Welcome to the Frontier
quest.slfrontier.meet_vysache.journal: Emul, a Vorpal Bunny, brought you to Rabituza, the hidden nation of rabbits. Their king Vysache wants to meet the human the Nightslayer chose.
quest.slfrontier.meet_vysache.objective: Meet Vysache on his throne in Rabituza.
quest.slfrontier.meet_vysache.title: The Rabbit King
quest.slfrontier.moonblades.journal: Vysache can awaken the Vorpal Choppers into something far stronger, but he needs the shell of a Quad Beetle — armored giants that roam the crystal grotto.
quest.slfrontier.moonblades.objective: Bring both Vorpal Choppers and a Quad Beetle Shell (Prismatic Forest Grotto) to Vysache.
quest.slfrontier.moonblades.title: Awakening the Vorpal Choppers
quest.slfrontier.nightslayer_encounter.j: Hunters whisper about a black stone altar deep in the dark woods. Touch it after nightfall and the Nightslayer comes — one of the Seven Colossi, a wolf no player has ever wounded. Everyone says you can't win. Go anyway.
quest.slfrontier.nightslayer_encounter.o: Find the Nightslayer's Den and touch the altar after dark. You will not be ready.
quest.slfrontier.nightslayer_final.journ: The Tombguard rests at last. Only the wolf remains. Learn Crescent Vorpal from Vysache, join Waxing and Waning into the Twin Moon, and return to the altar at night.
quest.slfrontier.nightslayer_final.objec: Return to the Nightslayer's Den at night and slay Lycagon. Vysache may teach you something first.
quest.slfrontier.nightslayer_final.title: The Night Must End
quest.slfrontier.not_started.journal: Somewhere out there is Shangri-La Frontier, the full-dive game everyone is talking about. All you need is a headset.
quest.slfrontier.not_started.objective: Craft a Full-Dive VR Headset and use it to log in.
quest.slfrontier.not_started.title: Logged Out
quest.slfrontier.tombguard.journal: Setsuna of Distant Days begged you to put her guardian to rest. Wezaemon the Tombguard, another of the Seven Colossi, has stood over her grave for an eternity and will not hold back. Parry his Sky Clear; quench his aura with Holy Water.
quest.slfrontier.tombguard.objective: Defeat Wezaemon the Tombguard. Parry his Sky Clear; douse him in Holy Water when his aura flares.
quest.slfrontier.tombguard.title: Unique Scenario EX: The Tombguard
sidequest.slfrontier.beetle_hunter.desc: "Quad Beetle shells! The hardest material in the grotto. I need three for an experiment — don't ask what kind."
sidequest.slfrontier.beetle_hunter.objec: Bring 3 Quad Beetle Shells to Bilac.
sidequest.slfrontier.beetle_hunter.title: Shell Collector
sidequest.slfrontier.goblin_cull.desc: "The goblins keep coming back, and the farmers are losing sleep. Twelve more and they'll get the message."
sidequest.slfrontier.goblin_cull.title: Goblin Cull
sidequest.slfrontier.lily_offering.desc: "He always picked the red lilies for me. Would you... gather some and leave them with me? I would like to remember."
sidequest.slfrontier.lily_offering.objec: Gather 8 Red Spider Lilies for Setsuna.
sidequest.slfrontier.lily_offering.title: A Garden for Two
sidequest.slfrontier.queens_crown.desc: "The Empire Bee Queen sits in a hive the size of a house in the Prismatic Forest Grotto. Topple her and her stingers are yours."
sidequest.slfrontier.queens_crown.object: Defeat the Empire Bee Queen in her hive.
sidequest.slfrontier.queens_crown.title: Long Live the Queen
sidequest.slfrontier.seasoned_adventurer: "Every pioneer who makes a name for themselves passes level 20 sooner or later. Come back when you have."
sidequest.slfrontier.shadow_pelts.desc: "Lycagon's shadows prowl the dark woods at night. Their fur drinks the light. Bring me some, and I will know you are ready to face their master."
sidequest.slfrontier.shadow_pelts.object: Collect 6 Nightslayer Fur from the shadows in the Nightslayer Woods.
sidequest.slfrontier.shadow_pelts.title: Shadows of the Nightslayer
sidequest.slfrontier.solo_killer.desc: "Something in the Diremarsh swallows lone adventurers whole. They call it the Mud Digger. Bring me its fin and I'll make it worth your while."
sidequest.slfrontier.solo_killer.objecti: Defeat the Mud Digger in its lair in the Diremarsh Waste and bring its fin to the Fastera Blacksmith.
sidequest.slfrontier.solo_killer.title: The Solo Killer
skill.slfrontier.crescent_vorpal.desc: Requires the Twin Moon. Leap and crash down in a crescent shockwave.
skill.slfrontier.cyclone_slash.desc: Spin with your blades, cutting everything around you.
skill.slfrontier.double_jump.desc: Passive. Press jump again in midair.
skill.slfrontier.drill_piercer.desc: Lunge and pierce the first enemy ahead. Huge damage on weak points (from behind).
skill.slfrontier.glowing_pierce.desc: Evolved Drill Piercer: a longer lunge that pierces every enemy in a line.
skill.slfrontier.moon_reflection.desc: Requires a Moonblade. A crescent of moonlight that cuts everything in front of you.
skill.slfrontier.perfect_parry.desc: Open a short window that nullifies an incoming attack.
skill.slfrontier.rabbit_gun.desc: With Emul at your side: she fires Magic Edge and launches you at the target.
skill.slfrontier.repel_counter.desc: Evolved Perfect Parry: a successful parry strikes back automatically.
skill.slfrontier.sky_clear.desc: Wezaemon's technique. A 360° cut so clean the clouds part.
skill.slfrontier.slide_step.desc: Evolved Tap Step: a longer dash with more invincibility.
skill.slfrontier.tap_step.desc: Dash a short distance, untouchable for a moment. Sneak to dash backward.
stat.slfrontier.agi.desc: Agility: faster movement, stronger dashes and jumps.
stat.slfrontier.luc.desc: Luck: +0.5%% critical chance per point, better luck.
stat.slfrontier.tec.desc: Technique: -1%% skill cooldowns per point (max 50%%), longer parries.
tooltip.slfrontier.greatsword: Greatsword: hold use to charge a crescent cleave.
tooltip.slfrontier.katana: Katana: hold use to draw, release for an iaijutsu dash.
tooltip.slfrontier.twin_blades: Twin blades: hold another twin blade in your off hand for follow-up strikes.
tooltip.slfrontier.twin_moon: Sneak-use with an empty off hand to split it back into two blades.
tooltip.slfrontier.twin_moon_hint: Sneak-use with Waxing and Waning in your hands to join them.
